Everything You Need to Eat Well, Every Single Day

MealCoreAI is not just a meal planner. It's the daily structure that keeps your health on track when life gets busy.

Your 7-day plan, ready in 90 seconds

Stop spending weekends planning meals. Answer a few questions about your health and preferences. Get a full week of breakfast, lunch, snack, and dinner instantly.

Ask anything, get a real answer

Not sure if methi is safe for your thyroid? Wondering if poha is okay for diabetes? Ask your AI diet assistant. Answers in seconds, not appointments.

Never forget an ingredient again

One tap turns your weekly plan into a grocery list with exact quantities. Share it on WhatsApp. No more double-trips to the sabzi mandi.

See your progress, no manual entry

Track calories, protein, calcium, and fibre for every meal automatically. Watch your daily nutrition score improve week over week.

Personalised reminders with your dish name

Get a push notification at 8 AM saying “Today’s breakfast: Ragi Dosa” — not a generic ‘time to eat’ alert. Never miss a meal again.

Bored of a dish? Swap it in one tap

Don't like today's lunch? Swap it instantly for something else that fits your health plan. Love it? Lock it so it keeps appearing in your plan.
